desc:
🌱 GROW • MOW • EARN 🌱

Start with a rusty mower and an overgrown lawn, and turn it into the best-looking yard in the neighborhood!

✂️ Cut grass to earn coins
🎨 Mow stripe patterns into your lawn
🗺️ Rebirth to unlock 5 new zones and trails!
⚡ Upgrade your Speed, Energy and Regrowth
🚜 Unlock better mowers, from the Push Reel all the way to the Zero-Turn!

But watch out: your grass grows back! The first patches you cut regrow first, so plan your route and keep mowing.

🎁 CODES 🎁
AUTUMN2026 → Unlock the Autumn skin for your mowers!
FRESHCUT → 3 Wheel Spins
MOWTIME → 15 Minutes of Double Coins


Redeem codes in the Shop → Codes tab!
👍 Like and ⭐ favorite to support the game. 200 LIKES = NEW CODE
